Ancients
Augustus (27 BC-AD 14), with Lucius Vinicius, as moneyer. AR denarius (17mm, 3.97 gm, 10h). NGC AU 4/5 - 2/5, brushed. Rome, 16 BC. AVGVSTVS-TR POT VII, bare head of Augustus right / L VINICIVS-L•FIII•VIR, cippus inscribed S•P•QR / IMP•CAE / QVOD•V / M•S•EX / EA P• Q IS / AD A• DE, legend in six lines. RIC I 360. Rare type. 

Born on 23 September 63 BC into a wealthy plebeian family, Augustus, originally Gaius Octavius, was the grandnephew and posthumously adopted son of Julius Caesar...

sales.description:
Ancients
Augustus (27 BC-AD 14). AR denarius (19mm, 3.85 gm, 12h). NGC Choice VF★ 3/5 - 4/5, brockage.  Incuse of reverse / AVGVSTI F COS DESIG PRINC IVVENT, Gaius and Lucius Caesars, togate, standing facing, each supporting grounded shield with inner hand, spears resting against shields; simpulum (on left) and lituus (on right) turned inwards above, C L CAESARES in exergue. Cf. RIC I 207 for reverse. A rare reverse brockage with great character. 

From the Eyeappealing Collection. Ex Heritage...
